name: Search in Files
description: Search for text inside files — the grep of this toolbox. Use it to find WHERE something is (a function, a setting, a message) before reading or editing it. It returns locator lines 'path:line: matching text', never whole file contents: open the interesting one with file_read. Searches a folder tree recursively (default: the agent workspace), skipping binaries and machine-generated folders. The search is literal and case-insensitive unless you say otherwise. The result always states how many matches exist in total, so a short list never means 'that is all there is'.

query.description: Text to look for. Plain text by default — punctuation and symbols are matched literally. A Python regular expression when regex=true

path.description: File or folder to search. Relative = inside the workspace. Default '.' = the whole workspace, searched recursively

pattern.description: Glob filter on file names, e.g. '*.py' or '*.py,*.md' (comma-separated). Default: every readable text file

regex.description: Treat 'query' as a Python regular expression (default false)

limit.description: Maximum number of matching lines printed (default 30, max 200)

context.description: Lines shown before and after each match, 0 to 3 (default 0 = only the matching line)
